jobs.title: Food Safety Trainer
jobs.reason: The role requires essential QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) industry experience and food-safety/store-operations expertise the candidate does not have, plus a background delivering technical training — none of which fits the profile. It also almost certainly requires working Spanish for in-store training in Spain, and it falls entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow or Senior Policy Fellow, US Development Policy Program
jobs.reason: Location policy is London only; this role is based in Washington DC with no London or fully-remote-UK option, so it is a hard location exclusion. It is also a Fellow / Senior Fellow level role beyond entry-level.

jobs.title: Fellow, Climate policy & development
jobs.reason: A "Fellow" title at a think-tank typically denotes a senior, experienced researcher rather than an entry-level post, placing it beyond the candidate's student-assistant/RA level. Climate and development policy also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to join an advisory committee, not an entry-level paid role — it seeks senior specialists with a track record on defender criminalisation, which the candidate does not have, and it reads as an advisory/voluntary position rather than a genuine paid vacancy. The human-rights subject is a strong interest match, but the level and nature of the role are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor - Nature Progress Oncology
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD in Oncology/Biology as an essential qualification, which the candidate does not hold, and the subject-matter expertise in cancer research is entirely outside their field. This is a hard mismatch on both qualification and domain.

jobs.title: Associate Professor / Head of Department, Nursing Education
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD in Nursing, SANC professional registration and 5+ years of senior leadership — multiple essentials the candidate cannot meet. It is a senior professorial/management role in nursing education, entirely outside the candidate's field and level.

jobs.title: Research Integrity Manager
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — this is a management position requiring line-management experience and demonstrable research-integrity experience overseeing a team of advisers, which the candidate does not have. The publishing-ethics field is only tangential to the candidate's core interests, and the level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Associate Editor, Discover Journals (Materials and Chemistry)
jobs.reason: The role requires a PhD (or MS with research experience) specifically in materials and chemistry — a hard science qualification and subject-matter expertise the candidate does not hold. It is entirely outside the candidate's IR/law field and interest zones.

jobs.title: Research Integrity Specialist
jobs.reason: The role requires a "proven track record as a high-performing Research Integrity Adviser (or equivalent role)" plus a strong background in statistical methods (GRIM, SPRITE) and specialist image-integrity software — this is a specialist, not entry-level, position demanding prior integrity-investigation experience the candidate lacks. The STEM-leaning publishing-ethics focus also sits well outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Research Integrity Adviser
jobs.reason: Entry-friendly on level (graduate degree in STEM or HSS, no fluency-in-Chinese requirement stated as essential), and the candidate's publishing/research background and academic-integrity familiarity partly transfer. However, it wants specific academic-publishing-process and plagiarism/image-detection tool experience the candidate lacks, and it sits outside all three core interest zones, so it is a weak fit worth only a marginal surface.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator – Chad, Central Africa
jobs.reason: Requires fluency in French and strong proficiency in Arabic as essentials, neither of which the candidate meets (B1 French, no Arabic); the position is also restricted to Chadian nationals. Transitional justice is a perfect interest match, but the language and nationality requirements are hard disqualifiers.

jobs.title: Finance and Project Officer – Chad, Central Africa
jobs.reason: Requires fluency in French and strong proficiency in Arabic as essentials, which the candidate lacks, and the role is restricted to Chadian nationals. The finance/administrative focus is also less aligned with the candidate's profile.

jobs.title: Head of Brand Campaigns
jobs.reason: This is a senior "Head" role requiring significant experience leading organisation-wide international campaigns plus strong line-management and budget-management experience — well beyond entry-level and outside the candidate's limited comms/marketing background. The disqualifying level and required marketing-leadership experience make it a hard mismatch, and the field is outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Management Consulting, Executive Assistant
jobs.reason: This is an administrative executive-support role — calendar, travel and inbox management — not a research or analyst position, so despite Teneo being a target firm in zone (b), the paper fit is weak against the candidate's research and policy profile. It is entry-level and eligible, and the candidate's project-administration experience is relevant, but the role offers little of the analytical work the candidate is aiming for, and dedicated EA experience is limited. Interest is low as this sits outside the candidate's core research zones.

jobs.title: Communications Planning Manager
jobs.reason: This is a Manager-level role with essential requirements of proven communications-planning experience across a complex organisation and a track record of leading campaigns and managing stakeholders — well beyond the candidate's student-assistant experience and outside their limited comms/campaign background. The level and essential experience are hard mismatches, and communications planning is not a core interest zone.
jobs.salary: £43,277–£51,714 pa (progression to £55,497) inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Emergency Response Manager
jobs.reason: Manager-level role requiring significant professional experience in emergency response and a track record of securing and overseeing Start Network / DEC programmes — well beyond the candidate's student-assistant / RA background. The seniority and operational humanitarian experience are unmet essentials.
jobs.type: Full-time (fixed term to May 2027, maternity cover)

jobs.title: Insight Manager
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — a Manager role requiring "significant experience" of designing/delivering insight and evaluation, acting as an authority, and demonstrable experience of leading cross-functional teams, none of which the candidate has. It is also internal-applicants-only and a communications/insight specialism far from the candidate's research and policy profile.
jobs.salary: £43,277 to £51,714 pa (up to £55,497 pa) inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.reason: A "Manager" role with essential requirements including proven brand-management and digital-asset-management expertise plus line-management experience — none of which the candidate has; it is also internal-applicants-only. It is a communications/brand specialist post well outside the candidate's research and policy profile and interest zones.
jobs.salary: £43,277 to £51,714 pa inclusive, progressing to £55,497 pa

jobs.title: Global People Operations Specialist
jobs.reason: This is an entry-level HR operations administrative role that the candidate could technically hold, but it demands HR-specific interest and systems (HiBob, HRIS, service-desk tools) rather than the candidate's research and policy strengths. It sits well outside all three interest zones, so while eligible, it is a poor fit on both skills alignment and interest and barely worth surfacing.

jobs.title: Events Officer
jobs.reason: Genuinely entry-level and open to varied backgrounds, but it is a dedicated events-and-marketing specialist role (logistics, CRM, event campaigns) — an area where the candidate has only limited experience and no core research component. The Institute for Government sits in adjacent policy territory rather than the candidate's core mission zones, so interest pull is modest.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert advisory committee members, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established experts (likely activists/practitioners from the named regions) to advise, effectively a volunteer/speculative advisory posting rather than a genuine paid vacancy. It also implies senior subject-matter expertise the candidate lacks, and the location is unspecified with no London base confirmed. The human-rights subject is interesting, but this is not a role the candidate can take up.
